title: JA Nova wp7 1.1.8: article, author, project, stat, related, video-intro, position and expertise blocks match the Joomla source heights at 320–1440px
steps: S1: Read the shipped wp-ja-nova stylesheet and the overlay stylesheet in the checkout; strip comments and flatten whitespace. Both must carry the 1.1.8 rules (article title 32px, author name 24px up to 991.98px, stat title min-height, project tag row nowrap below 576px, video-intro pull-up, position row flex and title line box, expertise box padding and pill margins) and style.css must read Version: 1.1.8.

S2: Read tasks/ja-nova-wp7/release/fix-measure.json: it was taken by site-sweep.mjs on the released zip (its sha256 equals the wp-ja-nova-1.1.8.zip line of SHA256SUMS), all 11 checks pass with 0 heights defects, and its baseline is 1.1.7 whose heights check failed.
expect: S1: every rule is present in both stylesheets and the version line reads 1.1.8.
S2: the release measure is bound to the released zip, 11/11 checks pass, heights has 0 open groups, and the 1.1.7 baseline failed heights.
evidence: Full site sweep of 07/10/2026 UTC on the clean restore of the packed 1.1.8 site against the local Joomla source: 11/11 checks, heights 0 open and 3 accepted (D-02, D-07, D-17), 0 not measured; the 1.1.7 baseline had 18 open heights groups
fence: Static presence of each 1.1.8 rule in the shipped and overlay stylesheets plus the recorded release measure; browser-measured behaviour is covered by the site sweep that produced the measure
